newsitem.title: USA: Family Bargain March same-store sales up.
newsitem.headline: Family Bargain March same-store sales up.

text.p: Family Bargain Corp Thursday reported sales for the five-week period ended April 5 rose 21.8 percent to $27.1 million, compared with $22.2 million last year. Comparable-store sales for March increased 4.8 percent.

Sales for the nine weeks ended April 5 were $41.4 million, an increase of 18.9 percent over sales of $34.8 million for the first nine weeks of fiscal 1996. Same-store sales increased 3.2 percent for the nine-week period ended April 5. The company operated 156 stores as of April 5.
